result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with standard transverse crosswalks and overhead traffic signals. Pedestrians face significant exposure due to the long crossing distance and lack of physical refuge islands or high-visibility markings.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the image

hazards.name: Low Visibility Crosswalks
hazards.description: The crosswalks are marked with thin transverse lines which are less visible to approaching drivers than high-visibility patterns.
hazards.location_in_image: The transverse lines marking the crosswalks on the pavement

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left and trees on the right may block sight lines between pedestrians and turning drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides approaching the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace transverse lines with continental or ladder style markings to improve driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles by tightening the turn radius.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with a high-visibility marked crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like traffic signals and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and degraded sidewalk condition on the right present challenges for pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Degraded sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right side of the image shows significant cracking and uneven surfaces, posing a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground sidewalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the cracked sidewalk on the right to ensure a smooth, accessible path for all users.

result.summary: The environment is dominated by high-speed vehicle traffic with multiple lanes and a slip lane, lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure like marked crosswalks or signals. Pedestrians are provided with only narrow, minimally protected islands and disconnected walkways, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross the multi-lane roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: High-speed slip lane
hazards.description: A dedicated right-turn lane allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, increasing risk to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, separated by a narrow island.

hazards.name: Inadequate pedestrian refuge
hazards.description: The concrete island provided for pedestrians is very narrow and offers little protection from traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, between the through lanes and the slip lane.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon or Signal
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-actuated signals to provide protected crossing intervals across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Slip Lane Reconstruction
interventions.description: Reconfigure the slip lane with a tighter turn radius or a 'truck apron' to slow down turning vehicles and improve sightlines.

result.summary: This wide, multi-lane intersection is highly hostile to pedestrians, featuring a complete lack of marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or refuge islands. The environment is dominated by vehicle-oriented design with long crossing distances and significantly degraded pavement surfaces.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without any designated or protected space, increasing the risk of conflict with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the entire intersection

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The extreme width of the intersection exposes pedestrians to traffic for a long duration without any mid-crossing refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire width of the roadway

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and wear in the roadway surface create tripping hazards and may affect vehicle braking performance.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground and center

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crossings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide safe crossing intervals.
